_comment: Real solo-violin recordings + matching scores for server/replay_check.py and `npm run replayScore`. Files go in server/tmp/recordings/ (gitignored), named as below. held_out pieces must never be used to tune anything -- check them only once a change is finished.

recordings.name: bwv1004-giga
recordings.notes: Fast 12/8 sixteenths with constant string crossings. Repeats not played; the MIDI has none either.

recordings.name: bwv1004-corrente
recordings.notes: 3/4 with triplets and dotted rhythms, some double stops. Repeats not played; the MIDI doesn't unfold them.

recordings.name: bwv1004-allemanda-qmul
recordings.audio_license: CC0, recorded at Queen Mary University of London 2013-04-18 (different performer from the dev set)
recordings.notes: 3:02 suggests repeats ARE played; check the .ly before trusting the result.

recordings.name: bwv1004-allemanda-vicond
recordings.notes: Same score as the QMUL take: two performers on one piece.

recordings.name: bwv1006-menuet1
recordings.notes: Slower texture, two voices in places. The performer repeats only the first section (A A B: 126 qn in 68 s; unfolding both repeats left the alignment stopping at 125.7 of 204 qn). The Mutopia MIDI unfolds neither, so the score file is the MIDI with bars 1-8 duplicated (mido, by tick: section boundary at 24 quarter notes).

recordings.name: paganini-caprice1
recordings.notes: Cut from the full concert at 11-126 s (located by subsequence DTW of the score's reference features against the whole concert; extract the audio with ffmpeg -vn -ac 1 -ar 48000).

recordings.name: paganini-caprice2
recordings.notes: Cut from the full concert at 127-294 s (located by subsequence DTW of the score's reference features against the whole concert; extract the audio with ffmpeg -vn -ac 1 -ar 48000).

recordings.name: paganini-caprice3
recordings.notes: Cut from the full concert at 296-476 s (located by subsequence DTW of the score's reference features against the whole concert; extract the audio with ffmpeg -vn -ac 1 -ar 48000).

recordings.name: paganini-caprice2-norepeat
recordings.notes: Cut from the full concert at 127-294 s (located by subsequence DTW of the score's reference features against the whole concert; extract the audio with ffmpeg -vn -ac 1 -ar 48000). Score variant: Mutopia's unfolded MIDI with each immediately repeated block kept once (.scratch/fold_repeats.py) -- testing whether the performer skips the repeat.
